question: How should the form be tapered from the middle of the head to the attached end?
premises: The tapering begins from the middle of the head.
The tapering extends up to the attached end.
The form must become gradually slender.
inference: One should make the form gradually slender from the middle of the head up to the attached end.
plain_english: Make it gradually slender from the middle of the head up to the attached end.
